simple.meaning: מִשְׁאָלָה (mishʼâlâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a request.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִשְׁאָלָה (H4862) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 20:6, with occurrences in Psalms.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִשְׁאָלָה (H4862) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִשְׁאָלָה (H4862) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִשְׁאָלָה (mishʼâlâh) / H4862 is traced through Psalms 20:6, Psalms 37:4 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4862. mishalah [ מִשׁאָלָה ] noun feminine request, petition ; — plural construct לִבָּ֑ךָ מִשְׁאֲלֹת Psa 37:4 (with נָתַן , of ׳י ); suffix מִשְׁאֲלוֺתֶיךָ 20:6 (with מִלֵּא , of ׳י ).

occurrences.englishText: Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed.
